results.title: Nyakuhwa earns praise from boss Mullins
results.description: Newport County winger Tanatswa Nyakuhwa has drawn praise after his impressive performance during their EFL Trophy win over Swindon. The Welsh U21 international made his first start for the Exiles against the Robins and grabbed a goal and an assist, alongside winning a penalty during the 2-0 win. Nyakuhwa, who struggled for minutes during his loan spell at County last season, has drawn praise from County boss Hayden Mullins for his efforts so far this season.

results.title: Built in 1989, Late NBA star Jason Collins’ longtime Los Angeles home spans 5,000+ sq ft, listed for $3.75 million; he bought it for $2.39 million in 2004
results.description: Late NBA star Jason Collins’ longtime Los Angeles home has been listed for $3.75 million. Collins purchased the 5,000+ sq ft property for $2.39 million in 2004 and lived there for more than two decades. Built in 1989, the red-tile-roof residence features spacious interiors, four en-suite bedrooms, a pool, patio and large hot tub.
